findings.F1: In a falling market (60-day return below -10 %, calm or agitated), a shrinking 30-day volume against the 30 days before is followed by the coin carrying on its 30-day direction. The 5-day unusual move, signed by that direction, averages +2.96 % (t 2.57 with each day's cases taken together; 194 cases on 66 days). When volume grew instead, it averages -1.74 % (t -1.01; 175 cases on 61 days).
findings.F2: Split by thirds of the volume ratio, falling-market grid cells in the most-shrunk third have a 5-day unusual return of -2.31 % (t -2.44, 134 cases). The middle third shows +0.19 % (t 0.25) and the growing third +0.59 % (t 0.51). The continuation sits in the dry-up, not in the fall alone.
findings.F3: Shrinking volume also comes with continuation outside falling markets. In rising markets the signed move is +3.14 % (t 2.02, 61 days) and in choppy ones +4.41 % (t 2.03, 40 days), against +1.80 % (t 1.28) and +2.18 % (t 1.72) when volume grew. This goes against the brief's claim that the effect lives only in the calm downtrend.
findings.F4: The book's sign of the market, all grid cells together, is weak (5-day drift +0.71 %, usual move 12.3 %). Within the tested regime, the short cases earn +0.71 % per cell (t 1.03, 277 cells). The book loses on its ten worst days when the coins rise +3.6 % to +8.3 %, and earns on its ten best when they fall -4.4 % to -14.7 %. It is a plain short of continued falls, hurt by squeezes.
findings.F5: Next-day returns after Thursday and Friday bars average +0.57 % and +0.53 % (t 3.86 and 3.88, about 1,190 days each). The excess is concentrated in rising markets: +1.02 % unusual, t 2.35, 117 days, against +0.08 % (t 0.27) on other weekdays. This repeats 045-01 (rising market late-week gain), already held, so it is not a discovery.
findings.F6: The other angles show nothing that holds up across this many tests. Deciles and quintiles of the 30-day and 5-day return, the day's range, close position, 20-day volatility and the 5-day volume ratio give no monotone grading (the largest Spearman rho is 0.15). The short book's gain after the prior day's move shows no pattern either.

ideas.idea: In a falling market, the more a coin's volume over its last 30 days has shrunk against the 30 days before, the further it keeps falling over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In any downtrend, calm or agitated, volume drying up is a graded reason to stay short or refuse a long, and growing volume is a warning the fall may stall.
ideas.name: falling volume dry-up continuation
